*Last updated: 28 July 2026*

This is a personal portfolio site. It sells nothing, has no accounts, and
collects as little as it can get away with.

## Analytics

The site uses Google Analytics 4 in **cookieless** mode. No `_ga` cookies are
written, nothing is stored in your browser between visits, and IP addresses are
anonymised before processing. What is recorded is aggregate: which pages get
read, roughly where traffic comes from, and which links referred it. There is
no way for me to tie any of that back to you, and no returning-visitor
tracking.

If you would rather send nothing at all, any content or tracker blocker will
stop the requests, as will your browser's "Do Not Track" or equivalent setting
in blockers that honour it.

## Contact form

The contact form on the [home page](/#contact) is handled by
[Formspree](https://formspree.io/legal/privacy-policy). Whatever you type into
it — your name, email address, and message — is transmitted to Formspree and
forwarded to my inbox. It is used to reply to you and nothing else: no mailing
list, no sharing, no resale. You can email me directly at
[noah@noahweidig.com](mailto:noah@noahweidig.com) instead if you would rather
skip the intermediary.

## Scheduling

The "Book a Call" links go to [Cal.com](https://cal.com/privacy), which handles
its own booking data under its own privacy policy.

## Hosting and fonts

The site is static, served by GitHub Pages, with deploy previews on Netlify.
Both keep standard server request logs, which I do not have access to. Fonts
are self-hosted, so no font CDN sees your visit.

## Your rights

If you are in the EU, UK, or another jurisdiction with data protection law and
want to know what I hold about you, or want it deleted, email
[noah@noahweidig.com](mailto:noah@noahweidig.com). In practice the only thing
that ever exists is a message you sent me yourself.
